summary: Menu search getlin repaints the map over an active menu. C keeps the physical menu while flushing only dirty gbuf cells; JS clears and rebuilds the full screen at the prompt flush.

source.branch: MENU_SEARCH while gameplay PICK_ANY menu is displayed and hero coordinates initialized; hooked_tty_getlin opens its prompt through custompline/flush_screen
dependencies: Canonical level.at(x,y).gnew is existing C gbuf dirty-cell state; show_glyph_cell sets it and flush_screen clears it.
C ttyDisplay.inread increments before custompline and decrements before clear_nhwindow; model one counter on existing nhDisplay with finally cleanup.
Existing windows.c:getlin and select_menu bot_disabled lifetimes preserve status rows; no new menu snapshot or active-menu owner required.
Separate later pray.c:fix_worst_trouble TROUBLE_STONED discards make_stoned via note_unported; no ownership in this menu flush fix.

evidence: Accepted A171 v32 evidence records32/63 matching screens with full2580 RNG and63/63 cursors; the number of matched screens is not a prefix. .cache/A174/selected-before.json reproduces first screen difference at zero-based step16 colon, row2,column1, C [ versus JS blank.

C wintty.c1705–1709 reads Search for with tty_getlin while preserving menu rows. getline.c43–64 raises ttyDisplay.inread before custompline; its exit214 decrements before clearing WIN_MESSAGE. display.c2208–2267 flushes gbuf rows/cells only when gnew (or configured framecolor), then updates cursor. No dirty map cells exist while the player searches this unchanged menu.

JS tty_menu.js1264/1509 has canonical PICK_ONE/PICK_ANY menu search, but getline.js157 flushes when u.ux exists; display.js _buildScreenOutput clears the terminal grid and redraws every map cell. Thus menu rows disappear before the source prompt is read. Startup-only tty_menu tests with u.ux absent cannot expose the bug.

Whole getter/menu/renderer ownership is excluded. Bounded source-backed fix uses the existing dirty-cell owner during getlin physical-screen flush, keeps unchanged menu cells, applies dirty map cells including blanks, retains cursor and existing status behavior, and forwards C inread counter lifetime with finally cleanup. Root explicitly approved the shared contract before implementation.

Validation: fail-first live-map PICK_ONE/PICK_ANY search tests checking menu cells beneath prompt, exact cursor/selection and ordinary prompt behavior; dirty-glyph blank write and counter cleanup tests; independent C-first intrinsic search primary/cheap variation and one outside-menu getlin route; exact selected replay. The later prayer make_stoned frontier is separate and may leave additional unmatched screens after this function.
